description: The bar chart illustrates the “Popularity” of different large language models (LLMs) — Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT — across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, with additional bars representing subsets of answers based on accuracy (Acc=0 or Acc=1) and ground truth (GT Ans) or generated answers (Gene Ans). The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity,” ranges from 0 to 220 in increments of 20, and the horizontal axis categorizes the domains. In the “Movies” category, Llama3 (blue, solid) and Qwen2 (red, solid) show moderate popularity (~40–50), while ChatGPT (yellow, solid) is slightly lower (~30). The “Acc=0 & GT Ans” (blue hatched) and “Acc=0 & Gene Ans” (red hatched) bars are very low (~20–30), and “Acc=1 & GT Ans” (white) is also low (~20). In “Songs,” Llama3 and Qwen2 rise to ~70–80, ChatGPT to ~60, and the accuracy-based bars remain low (~30–50). In “Basketball,” popularity peaks: Llama3 reaches ~180, Qwen2 ~200, and ChatGPT ~170; “Acc=0 & GT Ans” and “Acc=0 & Gene Ans” are ~100–150, and “Acc=1 & GT Ans” is ~140. The chart suggests that model popularity varies significantly by domain and is higher for models with more accurate or ground-truth-aligned responses, especially in Basketball. The bars are grouped by domain, with each group containing six bars corresponding to the legend entries, and the chart uses color and pattern to distinguish models and answer types.
